localization.first_half_cycle_net_tendency: candidate heating is generally lower or electron cooling is stronger
localization.second_half_cycle_net_tendency: candidate heating is generally equal or higher
localization.spatial_tendency: candidate heating is higher in the 0.0-0.2 and 0.8-0.9 gap fractions and lower in the 0.2-0.4 and 0.6-0.8 fractions
localization.interpretation_boundary: Opposing phase and spatial differences cancel strongly in the volume-cycle integral; four-cycle local current and power fluctuations require seed uncertainty before mechanistic interpretation.

assessment.finding: The 12.48 percent power-per-electron deficit is the ratio of a 1.92 percent power-density deficit to a 12.07 percent electron-density excess. It is not evidence of a 12.48 percent total power-deposition error. Local current and power remain the principal mismatch.
assessment.next_target: Run independent candidate seeds with the same matched protocol to quantify uncertainty in phase-resolved current and power before changing solver physics.

claim_boundary: This descriptive public-simulation comparison localizes discrepancies but does not establish experimental accuracy, predictive validation, or prospectively accepted cross-code agreement.
